the simplified tax regime aims to reduce compliance burden and provide relief to taxpayers. it includes features like reduced tax rates, increased exemptions, and a more streamlined filing process

of course, there are several ways to save taxes on your income, including investing in tax-saving instruments, claiming deductions, and taking advantage of tax credits. i can provide more specific advice if you'd like
